stories.title: Colombian Air Force plane crashes with scores of soldiers on board
stories.summary: Colombia's defence minister says it was a 'tragic accident' but the cause is not yet clear.

stories.title: Ex-teacher accused of Scotland school abuse found guilty of sex attack in South Africa
stories.summary: A court in Cape Town found Iain Wares guilty of indecently assaulting a former student who accused him of sexual abuse in the 1980s.

stories.title: Israeli strike on Lebanon bridge raises fears of ground invasion
stories.summary: Lebanon fears that Israel’s attack on Qasmiyeh Bridge could be a “prelude to a ground invasion”.

stories.title: US' and Iran's options for ending war narrow the longer it goes on
stories.summary: Iran shows no sign of climbdown, while air power alone cannot achieve the US' main goal.

stories.title: Blast that injured two was 'terrorist attack', Ukrainian authorities say
stories.summary: The suspect is a 21-year-old local resident who claims he was blackmailed and forced to plant explosives.

stories.title: Energy, water, bonds: What are Iran’s targets if Trump hits power plants?
stories.summary: Donald Trump's Strait of Hormuz deadline for Iran raises concerns about attacks on energy in the Middle East.

stories.title: Trump signals off-ramp in Iran war despite no ‘regime change’
stories.summary: President Donald Trump has ordered the US military to postpone strikes against Iranian power plants and energy.

stories.title: Oil falls and shares rebound after Trump says talks have been held to end war
stories.summary: Energy prices fall and stock markets rebound after the US president says "very good and productive" talks have been held.

stories.title: Australia's ABC staff to go on strike for first time in 20 years
stories.summary: The 24-hour long strike is expected to disrupt live television and radio broadcasts.

stories.title: Germany has a shortage of workers - so it's turning to India for help
stories.summary: The European nation, struggling to find skilled staff, is giving jobs to young people from India.

stories.title: France's Socialists hold on to power in major cities in election boost for mainstream
stories.summary: Paris and Marseille are held by the Socialists in local elections which saw the nationalist right win in Nice and certain towns.

stories.title: Israeli settlers target Palestinian villages in occupied West Bank, attacking people and properties
stories.summary: The violence began after 18-year-old settler Yehuda Sherman was killed after reportedly being hit by a vehicle driven by a Palestinian while on his quad bike.

stories.title: National blackout hits Cuba for second time in a week
stories.summary: Another total failure of its power grid underlines Cuba's hardship under a US-imposed fuel blockade.

stories.title: Israel to expand ground and air attacks against Hezbollah in Lebanon
stories.summary: There are fears in Lebanon that Israel is preparing for a large-scale ground invasion.

stories.title: Iranian missiles injure 180 in towns near Israeli nuclear site
stories.summary: Israel is investigating how ballistic missiles got through the country's sophisticated air defences.

stories.title: Qatari and Turkish citizens die in military helicopter crash
stories.summary: Four Qatari military personnel, one Turkish serviceman and two technicians from a Turkish defence company were on board.

stories.title: Sudan drone attack on key hospital killed 64 people during Eid, WHO says
stories.summary: The strike killed 64 people, including 13 children, two nurses and a doctor, according to the WHO head.

stories.title: Car stolen with two-month-old baby inside
stories.summary: The baby boy was rescued by police unharmed and reunited with his mother shortly after the ordeal.

stories.title: Venezuelan leader replaces senior military commanders
stories.summary: The reshuffle follows Delcy Rodríguez's appointment of a new defence minister, a move human rights groups described as a "recycling of impunity".
